topic: Side hustle weekends vs Netflix weekends (Reid vs Harper)

scenes.narration: Two hours every Saturday turned into ten thousand dollars in one year. I am Coach Vault and today the side hustle pays. Today's training session begins now!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault in a gym holding a stopwatch in one hand and a stack of cash in the other, comic burst banner reads TEN THOUSAND IN A YEAR, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Reid and Harper are both salaried employees making fifty five thousand a year and both have free Saturdays and Sundays.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel, left side man reid on a couch, right side woman harper at a laptop, both in workout gear with weekends marked on a calendar, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Reid spends every weekend on the couch streaming and ordering takeout. He says he is too tired from his day job to do anything else.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man reid sprawled on a couch with takeout and a remote, comic banner reads TIRED, weekend calendar marked NETFLIX, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Harper does freelance graphic design for two hours every Saturday and another two on Sunday morning, charging forty dollars an hour.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman harper at a desk with a sketch tablet and a laptop, a small clock reading FOUR HOURS, dollar bills stacked beside the keyboard, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: After twelve months Reid has the same checking balance he started with and his streaming bill went up.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, shocked man reid at a kitchen table with a flat bank statement, comic banner reads SAME BALANCE, takeout boxes around him, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Harper banked nine thousand six hundred dollars in side income, paid off her car, and started building a real emergency fund.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split scene, left side reid on the couch, right side harper with a brokerage app showing NINE THOUSAND SIX HUNDRED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Trade four weekend hours for an income stream you control. The money is not the only win, the skill is yours forever. Drop and give me twenty bucks!
